summary: Teaching additive synth: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. Up to 64 sine partials of a harmonic series with a brightness tilt, odd/even balance, a partial count, inharmonicity (stiff-string stretching), a comb of notches across the partials and a slow per-partial shimmer, an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for organs, pads, bells, choirs and pure tones, or to learn how additive synthesis works.

parameters.name: Brightness Tilt
parameters.description: Adjusts the amplitude roll-off slope across all active upper sine partials relative to the fundamental.
parameters.how: Adjusts the amplitude roll-off slope across all active upper sine partials relative to the fundamental.
parameters.sound: Tilting down yields warm, flute- or organ-like tones; tilting up produces bright, glassy textures.

parameters.name: Odd / Even
parameters.description: Attenuates either even-numbered harmonics (left) or odd-numbered harmonics (right) above the fundamental.
parameters.how: Attenuates either even-numbered harmonics (left) or odd-numbered harmonics (right) above the fundamental.
parameters.sound: Odd only sounds hollow and woody, like a clarinet; even only sounds thin and octave-like; in the middle the full series sounds rich, like a saw.

parameters.name: Partials
parameters.description: Sets the hard ceiling on how many harmonic sine waves are synthesized above the fundamental pitch.
parameters.how: Sets the hard ceiling on how many harmonic sine waves are synthesized above the fundamental pitch.
parameters.sound: At 1 you hear a pure sine wave; increasing the count progressively builds harmonic complexity.

parameters.name: Inharmonicity
parameters.description: Stretches upper partial frequencies away from integer multiples (partial n at n times the fundamental times the square root of 1 + B n squared).
parameters.how: Stretches upper partial frequencies away from integer multiples (partial n at n times the fundamental times the square root of 1 + B n squared).
parameters.sound: Transforms pure harmonic organ tones into stiff piano strings, chimes, and metallic bells.

parameters.name: Spectral Comb
parameters.description: Applies a sinusoidal amplitude notch mask across the 64 partials.
parameters.how: Applies a sinusoidal amplitude notch mask across the 64 partials.
parameters.sound: Carves hollow, phaser-like vocal formants and resonant notches into the harmonic spectrum.

parameters.name: Shimmer
parameters.description: Introduces independent low-frequency amplitude and micro-pitch drift to upper partials.
parameters.how: Introduces independent low-frequency amplitude and micro-pitch drift to upper partials.
parameters.sound: Creates a lush, living, choir-like movement across sustained chords.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.
